name: grid-atom
title: New Grid Atom
description: Creates a named CSS grid definition from an existing grid preset using data-grid and data-area selectors, retaining its area names and track topology.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated grid atom; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated grid atom.

settings.name: indexed
settings.title: Include in Index
settings.description: Whether the generated item should appear in its project manifest.

settings.name: location
settings.title: Atoms Folder
settings.description: Parent folder that will contain the new named atom folder.

settings.name: preset
settings.title: Source Preset
settings.description: Existing template used to create the named atom.
